values.quote: Each stack of ''Feast'' increases the damage by {{ap|8|12|16}}.
values.binNote: Notes-text value not reflected as a distinct data row; RDamage/RMonsterDamage calculations do not show a stacks term in the sheet, but the wiki states a per-stack damage increase - possibly the 'buffStacks' scaling used elsewhere (VorpalSpikes) applies analogously here but is not printed in this sheet excerpt.

mechanics.claim: Cho'Gath devours an enemy, dealing true damage based on Cho'Gath's bonus health.
mechanics.quote: '''Cho'Gath''' devours an enemy, dealing {{as|true damage}} based on {{as|'''Cho'Gath's bonus''' health}}.

mechanics.claim: Against non-champions, the base damage is modified (uses the 1200 base instead of the rank-based base).
mechanics.quote: Against non-{{tip|champions}}, the '''base''' damage is modified.

mechanics.claim: If the target enemy champion has health below the true damage amount, they are marked for execution; this does not account for shields or invulnerability.
mechanics.quote: If an enemy {{tip|champion}} has health below the amount of {{as|true damage}} ''Feast'' deals, they will be marked for execution. This indicator does not consider {{tip|shield|shields}} or {{tip|invulnerability}}.

mechanics.claim: If this attack kills the target, Cho'Gath gains a permanent Feast stack that infinitely stacks.
mechanics.quote: If this attack kills the target, '''Cho'Gath''' gains a permanent ''Feast'' {{tip|stack}} that infinitely stacks.

mechanics.claim: Only 6 stacks can be gained from non-epic monsters or minions.
mechanics.quote: Only 6 stacks can be gained from non-epic {{tip|monster|monsters}} or {{tip|minion|minions}}.
